content.text: Honestly I might rewrite the CSV exporter in Rust someday, if the Python one keeps getting slower. No plans yet.
That rewrite would be a big lift; the exporter is about two thousand lines with the plugins.
Anyway, what I need today is narrower: fix the flaky retry test in tests/test_sync.py.
On it. The retry test fails roughly once in ten runs on this machine.
Yes, about one in ten for me too.
